Seattle Turns Out for Award-Winning Documentary

Just off the coattails of its Jackson Wild Award, SENTIENT premiered in Seattle to massive acclaim! With over one hundred attendees, the film screening was followed by a Q&A with PETA scientist Dr. Lisa Jones-Engel, who is featured prominently throughout the documentary.

It’s Back! PETA’s Turkey Truck Shocks Shoppers

PETA’s notorious “Hell on Wheels” hyper-realistic turkey transport truck has kicked off a new tour to give shoppers a birds-eye view of what turkeys endure in transit and urge them to give the birds a break. Find out if the truck is headed your way!

Monkey Masks, Mobile Billboards, and a Message Vivisectors Couldn’t Escape

PETA supporters rallied outside the Society for Neuroscience Annual Meeting in DC, where advocates held an eye-catching demonstration. During the protest, a mobile billboard circled the venue, which spread our message far and wide.

H&M Wool Cruelty on Display in Dramatic Banner Drop

Shoppers got an eyeful when sheep supporters took over an H&M in London. This protest follows a PETA Asia investigation into a NATIVA-certified wool farm, where workers were filmed kicking and stomping on sheep, dragging lambs by their legs, and leaving animals with gaping wounds after shearing. The farm supplied H&M Group with wool marketed as “responsibly sourced.”

PETA UK Dishes Up Grisly Reality Behind Beef Burgers

A severed “cow’s” head turned heads outside a McDonald’s in Glasgow as PETA UK gave diners a face-to-face reminder of who ends up in their burgers, urging them to rethink their next Happy Meal.

PETA Supporters Take a Bullfighting Plea Straight to Pope Leo

After following Pope Leo from the Vatican all the way to Buenos Aires, animal advocates waited for hours for a fleeting chance to urge the Catholic Church to reject cruelty in the arena. Their unmissable signage reached the pontiff during a high-profile Popemobile appearance—and sparked conversations with worshippers afterward.

A Bloody Scene Greets Yet Another Raising Cane’s Grand Opening

A woman hanging upside down and screaming disrupted a grand opening of a Raising Cane’s to remind everyone of the terror chickens experience before ending up in a fast-food bag. Animal allies have held similar protests across the country to make the point that chickens should be left in peace, not pieces.

Robo-Turkey Helps Give Out Free ThanksVegan Roasts

PETA’s walking, squawking robotic turkey, Travis Beaker, is strutting his way through towns across America to give away free vegan roasts. The bionic bird, named in honor of Travis Barker, the vegan drummer for Blink-182, greets passersby with cheeky banter, including “Stuff yourself with vegan foods this ThanksVegan!”

Fixed, and Fabulous: We Gave 43 Virginia Cats a Fresh Start

With help from Homeward Trails, PETA fieldworkers trapped 43 cats on a rural Virginia property and got every one of them spayed or neutered and vaccinated at the local SPCA clinic. Now we’re looking for the purrfect homes for two especially sweet felines, Thomas and Natalia.

Sad ‘Camel’ Trapped in Snow Globe Turns Heads

As the Christmas Spectacular kicks off its holiday run, PETA gave Radio City Music Hall a shake-up with a sad, chained “camel” trapped inside a giant inflatable snow globe, as PETA supporters rallied alongside the display to call attention to the camels, sheep, and donkeys suffering in the show.
